claim_scope: Candidate C1-double-prime repair of the Opus C1 and C1-prime findings: the record containers may carry only the closed deserialize_with attribute naming a function produced by the pinned local bounded-vec macro whose implementation file is pinned and closed; both projection gates have pinned content (field tables, forbidden-key tables, test names) and seeded unknown-key property tests; the replay records the cargo version and runs the Rust refinement and golden suites; Cargo.lock is pinned, .cargo configs are rejected, manifests keep exact versions and default targets; macro locality is definition-before-invocation and unqualified; extern crate and same-line foreign imports are rejected; the Python container class is closed and dynamic rebinding is rejected; packet strings are printable ASCII and promotion tokens are NFKC-folded; ESSO replay checks query counts and ids; the Lean necessity theorem states the universal claim it refutes and definitional theorems are counted separately. Earlier: C2-prime re-pin (golden evidence joined the pin set); C1-prime repair of the Codex C1 audit findings: the Rust and Python projection scans now run under a lexical closure (no cfg, include, path attributes, item-defining or foreign item-position macros, single depth-zero definition, exact attribute block, no field attributes, serde-only imports, unconditional mod state, default Cargo targets, closed dataclass decorators, unrebound class names, literal to_canonical) and are bound to the compiled and imported types by two replay gates; the author replay record has a closed per-command comparable schema and an exact toolchain block compared on fresh replay; the test-hygiene packet is selected per required path as the newest matching packet (hygiene-gate rule) instead of a fixed path. Research-only source-bound evidence that the O-008 formal-cycle admission checker is a pure core behind a read-only Git shell, admits only a packet that is the projection of one exact source commit S committed as an artifact-only direct child P, hashes every pin from Git blobs at S, verifies its own executing bytes against S, checks the ordered Lean theorem inventory and the exact Python/Rust V1 terminal projection structurally, keeps the five-invariant ESSO surface and the drain mutant, reports proof replay as NOT_RUN unless it executes the recorded tools, and cannot raise the zero-authority claim ceiling.

a renamed, reordered, or weakened theorem passes an unordered name check

a packet author's replay record is treated as executed evidence

a contradictory nonclaim, promotion token, or COMPLETE lane status passes
the executing checker differs from the checker pinned at the subject
a cfg-disabled decoy struct or macro-generated live struct passes the textual scan
a well-shaped forged author replay record with a fabricated toolchain passes
a stale hygiene packet keeps admitting changed sources

aaa.reason: Each test arranges one exact snapshot, packet, topology, or observation set, invokes the pure core or the CLI once, and asserts the exact structured error code and claim ceiling.

reject_is_noop.reason: The builder refuses to write any output on rejection and the checker writes nothing; the only observables are the JSON report and the exit code, and the tests assert the on-disk outputs are absent after a rejected build.
